# Overview

`earthquakes` is an R package for querying USGS earthquake data, searching near
a location, calculating distances, grouping events in space and time, and
creating a static map.

## Query events

```{r}
library(earthquakes)
events <- get_earthquakes(start_time = "2026-01-01",
                          min_magnitude = 3, limit = 100)
head(events)
```

## Search near a location

The example coordinates are for Stockholm. The search radius is in kilometres.

```{r}
nearby <- get_nearby_earthquakes(
  latitude = 59.3293, longitude = 18.0686,
  radius_km = 100, min_magnitude = 1, limit = 500
)
```

## Calculate distances and identify clusters

```{r}
with_distance <- earthquake_distance(nearby, 59.3293, 18.0686)
clustered <- earthquake_clusters(nearby, distance_km = 50,
                                 time_window_hours = 24)
```

Clustering uses connected components based on the supplied thresholds. It is
intended for exploratory analysis, not definitive aftershock identification.

## Plot earthquake locations

```{r}
earthquake_map(events)
```

## Run the Shiny application

From the cloned repository root, run `shiny::runApp("inst/shiny")` after
installing the package and the Shiny dependencies.
